summary: NOVONIX Limited filed a Form 6-K with an ASX Appendix 2A, applying for quotation of 171,591 ordinary shares issued upon vesting of employee performance rights. This is a routine administrative disclosure of a small equity issuance under an employee incentive scheme, not a special situation. No transaction terms, premium, or strategic event are involved; the shares rank equally with existing ordinary shares. There is no deal to analyze or risk-arb angle.
